_about: Collected app versions — the website's single source, written from the Version Register (train-ai-models-data/VERSION-REGISTER.md). Audits collect versions from each app's own files; this file is refreshed from the register, and sync_versions.py applies it to the site during every website change. Only collected versions stand here — a slug with no entry keeps the site's stated version until its audit collects the real one.
